title: Thin-Seared Salmon Nigiri
description: Minimalist nigiri with thin salmon slices cooked quickly on both sides.

ingredients.name: Prepared, seasoned sushi rice
ingredients.note: Use the separate Sushi Rice recipe

steps: With damp hands, shape lightly compressed ovals from approximately 25 g of seasoned sushi rice each; avoid packing hard.
Slice salmon very thinly, then sear both sides quickly in a hot pan until each slice is opaque throughout.
Drape a piece of cooked salmon over each rice oval; gently press to conform without flattening the rice.
Brush a very small amount of soy sauce on top. Add a few scallion slices and optional tiny dots of Kewpie.
notes: A brief surface torching alone does not make thick salmon slices fully cooked.
This baseline yields approximately four rolls (or the equivalent nigiri, gunkan or hand-roll assortment), about six light servings.
Sushi rice is prepared and seasoned separately; the rice quantity here is its ready-to-use weight.
Salmon is fully cooked, including the very thin seared-slice variations; for thicker pieces, 63°C at the center is a conservative target.
